scope: Re-run the same canonical ReadyToSell site synchronization in the one existing F portable shared runner. Back up dirty allowed site paths, overlay only the remote branch ReadyToSell data, evidence assets and HTML onto the active 8012 checkout, then verify source/canonical/served counts and row-level source, photo, polygon, status and report visibility. Do not restart or create a runner.
acceptance: Dirty canonical ReadyToSell paths must be backed up before overlay.
Only allowed ReadyToSell site paths may be overlaid from the remote target branch.
The existing app and runner must not be restarted.
Health, page and JSON must return HTTP 200.
Served counts must match remote source counts for rows, live sources, photos and polygons.
No visual_match_score, VISION_COMPARED or 3.5+ confidence without separate real visual comparison.
Outer canonical runner must commit, push and remote-readback the verification output.
resume_reason: The active 8012 checkout still serves 30 rows because its allowed ReadyToSell paths are dirty. Preserve those paths in runner output backup, then selectively overlay the 115-row remote branch data without touching unrelated changes or starting another runner.
